text:
Maya: Heads-up — Peregrine is showing credit oscillations this week, spikes then drops. Noticing ~3x hourly variance on embeddings; probably onboarding automation running backfills.

Jon: Do we have an automated alert on this? Who owns pre-renewal accounts for Peregrine?

Maya: Not yet — spotted via dashboard. Assigning to Eli to run a spend forecast and propose guardrails. @Eli

Eli: On it. I'll run a 30d burn forecast and propose threshold alerts. Can someone paste the exact metric/account link?

Aisha (CS Ops): Dashboard link: https://redwood.app/dash/peregrine (has live token burn). Quick query I used to compute hourly burn: 
```sql
SELECT date_trunc('hour', ts) AS hr, SUM(tokens) as burn
FROM usage_events
WHERE account_id = 'acct_peregrine'
  AND ts > now() - interval '48 hours'
GROUP BY hr
ORDER BY hr;
```

Aisha (CS Ops): Recommend an interim alert: threshold = 80% of monthly committed tokens on a rolling 7d window. Config example: 
```yaml
alert: spend_threshold
threshold: 0.8
window: 7d
action: notify(#customer-success, @Jon)
```

Jon: Good. Can you also estimate runway and suggest temp throttles/quotas before the QBR? We should avoid surprise overage right before renewal.

Eli: Forecast completed — if current trend continues we'll hit ~1.6x committed spend in ~22 days. Uploading numbers to the shared doc and scheduling a 20-min triage.

Maya: Pinged the customer to align on any upcoming bulk runs. @Priya any planned mass ingests or large tests this week?

Priya (Peregrine): Thanks for flagging. We do have a staging bulk ingest scheduled next Tue (09:00 PT). Can we request a preflight test and, if needed, a temporary throttle? Also want clearer alerts.

Jon: Proposed immediate actions:
- Eli: run + share 30d forecast; create budget alert rule by EOD (OWNER: Eli)
- Aisha: apply temporary per-key throttle for staging and document rollback (OWNER: Aisha)
- Maya: schedule 30-min pre-QBR ops sync with customer and AE (OWNER: Maya)

Maya: I'll create the calendar invite and add agenda: preflight + mitigation plan + QBR slide points. Tagging docs: https://redwood.app/docs/cost-controls :thumbsup:

Eli: Created alert rule and sent DM to Priya about the staging window. Forecast spreadsheet uploaded: https://drive.redwood/peregrine/forecast.xlsx

Priya (Peregrine): Received — appreciate the quick turnaround. Please confirm when the throttle is live.

Aisha (CS Ops): Throttle applied to staging API keys (rate_limit: 30r/s). Rollback is /remove header X-CS-THROTTLE or revert flag in the console. Runbook steps and links posted to the shared folder.

Maya: Great. We'll review spend delta in the pre-QBR sync and include cost mitigation items in the QBR deck.

Jon: I'll own the QBR cost slide. Anyone have recent month-over-month comparison charts I can reuse?

Aisha (CS Ops): Uploaded last 3 months of charts here: https://drive.redwood/peregrine/cost-charts

Priya (Peregrine): Thanks everyone — confirmation received. Talk Tuesday for the preflight.

deploy-bot: Alert created: spend_threshold for acct_peregrine at 80% of commit — rule id r_93421
